title: Invalid tightening of second law: W_ext <= -dF + kT I_A does not follow

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Eq. (2ndlaw2) in section 3.1 and Theorem 'work' assert $\langle W_{ext}\rangle \le -\Delta F + k_BT I_A$ with $I_A=\mathcal I(X;A)$.

The given (hypothesis) second law is $\langle W_{ext}\rangle \le -\Delta F + k_BT I$ with $I=\mathcal I(X;Y)$. Lemma 'dpi' correctly proves $I_A \le I$. But then $-\Delta F + k_BT I_A \le -\Delta F + k_BT I$, so the claimed bound is **strictly stronger** than the hypothesis and does NOT follow from it. Replacing $I$ by the smaller $I_A$ goes the wrong direction.

The justification 'work is a functional of (X,A) only' shows the work ignores extra measurement detail, but this does not yield a refined bound with $I_A$ in place of $I$. A genuine refined second law (detailed fluctuation theorem / coupling, e.g. Horowitz-Vaikuntanathan continuous information reservoirs) would be required and is not provided.

Consequently Theorem 'work', Corollary 'power' (the $I_A$ form), the $I_A$-efficiency, and all $H(A)$/$N\log2$ corollaries are unproven. This is the central defect.
